source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Applying mainly to healthcare professionals themselves, rather than to members of the general public who might witness stroke symptoms","B":"Promote rapid recognition of stroke symptoms and prompt emergency response, since timely treatment significantly improves outcomes","C":"Having fairly little measurable impact on how quickly people ultimately seek treatment once stroke symptoms actually appear","D":"Taking the place of a professional medical evaluation once someone recognizes possible stroke symptoms in themselves or another person"}}
source_row.rationale: The "FAST" public education campaign promotes rapid recognition of stroke warning signs and prompt emergency response, since timely treatment significantly improves stroke outcomes, making public awareness a critical component of stroke systems of care.
source_row.source_name: AHA/ASA — Stroke Warning Signs Public Awareness Campaign
